page.notes: The line "tem libro secundo ..." at the start of the last line is the left edge of the text, read as "tem"; the first letter may be hidden by the fold. The Greek phrase after "libris" is hard to read and is only a best guess, marked [?]. The word "coĉta" has a doubtful letter. The mark "ꝛ" in "Medicinaꝛli" is uncertain. The small asterisk-like ornament below the text is a printer's ornament, not text, and is left out. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true".
